pm-changelog 2026.11.7 uses `const DEPENDABOT_SUBJECT = /^[\w-]+\((?:deps|deps-dev)\): bump /` in generator.ts. The lowercase-only `bump` rejects actual squash subjects such as `Build(deps-dev): Bump the pm-toolchain group across 1 directory with 3 updates (#106)`.

Reproduction: create a full Git repository with an older release tag and CHANGELOG section, only older closed items without release fields, then commit the subject above and request a newer release using `--since-previous-tag --until-release-tag --release-version-from-package --respect-item-release`. It raises MISSING_REQUESTED_RELEASE instead of emitting the dependency-only section. Lowercasing only `Bump` makes it succeed.

Public failing evidence: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-jev/actions/runs/43009061713 (job 130483756140). All 41 unassigned items are before the prior tag; this is not evidence that they need reassignment. Four new dependency bumps are ignored. In contrast https://github.com/unbraind/pm-brief/actions/runs/43059359608 succeeded today using the same flags and lowercase `bump` subjects, producing real dependency notes.

Please recognize the capitalization used by Dependabot/squash titles while retaining the deps/deps-dev scope and bump verb requirement. Add single-window and all-release-tags tests for capitalized Bump, including regeneration after tagging, and keep unrelated deps fixes excluded. pm-jev will use an in-repo preparation workaround without changing this package or its pin.
